title: R&M — Taylors Contracting: 2 missing family residence zones (Arthur, Mum)
notes: Wave 1 only seeded 4 of Taylors' 6 real addresses from the Details sheet (Taylors Quarry/Office and Taylors Yard/Office as client_sites; Charlie's and Matt's homes as location_zones). Arthur's (53 Tahi Street, Mapua, code MAPU) and Mum's (16 Lansdowne Rd, Appleby, code APPL) homes were missed. Added here as location_zones, matching the existing residential pattern (Charlie/Matt), not client_sites (which is reserved for the commercial quarry/yard properties).

Both geocoded live and confirmed real: Arthur's address matched directly. Mum's address needed a Nelson-region-qualified query (the bare address alone returned wrong-region matches in Auckland and Katikati) - the corrected match's suburb 'Appleby' matches the Details sheet's own APPL code for this address, confirming correctness.
